rationale: The candidate reads as a coherent neighborhood-living massing diagram: one dominant low rectangular body, a clear carved court/slot, and a legible response to the access edge through open ground rather than a sealed box. It is coherent in all four views, with the same primary gesture surviving the orbit and no obvious view-dependent collisions. The silhouette is more rectilinear than poetic, but the courtyard and upper notch give the form enough spatial consequence to support the brief. The main weakness is that the upper carving is somewhat generic and could be more evidently tied to section/daylight, but it does not break program fit. The received references reinforce courtyard-centered, horizontally spread, publicly legible neighborhood massing rather than sculptural object-building.
